2-4 项，每项最多 25 字符；填了就是投票推文，不能同时带媒体: 2-4 options, up to 25 characters each; filling this in makes it a poll tweet, and it can't be combined with media
MessageCreate 消息 / ParticipantsJoin 加入 /: MessageCreate message / ParticipantsJoin joined / ParticipantsLeave left
X 回显的正文（链接会被替换成 t.co 短链）: The text X echoes back (links are replaced with t.co short links)
X 搜索语法（如 `\"我的品牌\" -is:retweet lang:zh`）: X search syntax (e.g. `"my brand" -is:retweet lang:zh`); leave blank to not listen for keywords. **Every poll is a billed search** — don't set the interval too short
X 的搜索语法：`from:elonmusk`、`#AI -is:retweet: X search syntax: `from:elonmusk`, `#AI -is:retweet`, `"large language model" lang:zh`, `url:openai.com`. **By default it searches everything, including retweets** — add -is:retweet if you don't want them
impression_count；早期推文可能为 0: impression_count; may be 0 for older tweets
original 原创 / replied_to 回复 / retweeted: original = original tweet / replied_to = reply / retweeted = retweet / quoted = quote tweet
succeeded 才能用；视频转码由本操作等到结束: Only usable once succeeded; this operation waits for video transcoding to finish
上一批返回的 next_cursor: The next_cursor returned by the previous batch
上一批返回的 next_cursor。留空则从最近的开始: The next_cursor returned by the previous batch. Leave blank to start from the most recent
上一批返回的 next_cursor。留空则从最近的开始；接着上次拉就把它存进数: The next_cursor returned by the previous batch. Leave blank to start from the most recent; to continue from last time, save it to a data table
上一批返回的 next_cursor。留空则从最近的开始；有游标则只取比它更新的: The next_cursor returned by the previous batch. Leave blank to start from the most recent; with a cursor, only items newer than it are fetched
不可用时是原因；可用时是当前账号 @用户名: The reason when unavailable; the current account's @username when available
不带 @；与 id 二选一: Without the @; use either this or id
不带 @；与 id 二选一（填用户名会多花一次查询）: Without the @; use either this or id (filling in the username costs an extra lookup)
不带 @；填了则插件先查 id（多花一次查询）: Without the @; if filled in, the plugin looks up the id first (an extra lookup)
为假表示账号不存在/已封禁，不是错误: False means the account doesn't exist or is suspended; not an error
为真表示这批拉满了，应当立刻再拉一次: True means this batch is full and you should fetch again right away
书签是私密的，别人看不到: Bookmarks are private; no one else can see them
事件源自动维护，勿手填: Maintained automatically by the event source; don't fill in by hand
决定 media_category；用途填错 X 会在发布时拒绝这个 media: Determines media_category; getting the purpose wrong means X will reject this media_id at publish time
列表页地址 x.com/i/lists/<这一串>: The list page's URL, x.com/i/lists/<this string>
删掉/私密的推文不会出现在结果里，不是错误: Deleted or private tweets won't appear in the results; not an error
原样转发（要带评论就用「发推文」的引用）: Retweet as-is (to add a comment, use the quote option in "Post tweet")
发原创/回复/引用推文，可带图片视频与投票: Post an original, reply, or quote tweet, optionally with images, video, or a poll
发推、发推串、传图传视频、点赞转推、搜索与时间线、私信、列表，以及被提及 / 关: Post tweets and threads, upload images and video, like and retweet, search and read timelines, send DMs, manage lists, and trigger workflows on mentions / keyword matches.
发给某个人；与会话 id 二选一: Send to a specific person; use either this or conversation id
只挂在第一条上，最多 4 个: Only attached to the first tweet, up to 4
只有用户名的话，先过一次「查用户」: With only a username, first go through "Look up user"
只能删授权账号自己发的: Can only delete tweets posted by the authorized account itself
可直接点开，也可以直接发进通知里: Can be opened directly, or dropped straight into a notification
回复某个已有会话（私信事件里带这个字段）: Reply within an existing conversation (this field is included in DM events)
图是原图；视频给的是预览图——X 在这个接口不给视频源地址: Images are the original; for video this is a preview thumbnail — X doesn't give the source video URL through this endpoint
图片 ≤5MB、GIF ≤15MB、视频 ≤512MB。视频只收 MP4(H.2: Images ≤5MB, GIFs ≤15MB, video ≤512MB. Only MP4 (H.264/AAC) is accepted for video; X rejects other formats during transcoding
图片/GIF/视频 → media_id，供发推与私信使用。视频自动分片并等待转: Images/GIFs/video → media_id, for use in tweets and DMs. Video is automatically chunked and transcoding is awaited
填 on 则有人 @ 授权账号时触发工作流；off = 不监听: Set to on to trigger the workflow whenever someone @mentions the authorized account; off = don't listen
填了则整串挂在这条推文下；留空则第一条是原创: If filled in, the whole thread is attached under this tweet; leave blank for the first tweet to be original
填了就是回复。想回复某条推文的话，从「搜索」等操作的 id 字段绑过来: Filling this in makes it a reply. To reply to a specific tweet, wire it from the id field of operations like "Search"
如 http://127.0.0.1:7897；部署环境直连不了 x.com 时: e.g. http://127.0.0.1:7897; required when the deployment environment can't reach x.com directly
它的推文只有粉丝读得到，搜索也搜不出来: Its tweets are only visible to followers and won't turn up in search
对方是私密账号时为真: True when the other account is private
已展开成原地址（正文里是 t.co 短链，下游用不了）: Expanded to the original URL (the text only has the t.co short link, which downstream steps can't use)
引用转推。⚠️ X 把带引用的发推划进了 Enterprise 档，自助档会被拒: Quote tweet. ⚠️ X classifies posting with a quote under its Enterprise tier — self-service tiers will be rejected, so check your tier first
把多段文本发成一串首尾相连的推文；第一段可带媒体: Post several pieces of text as a connected thread of tweets; the first can include media
把账号加进 X 列表——配合「列表时间线」就是一套低成本的盯人方案: Add an account to an X list — combined with "List timeline", this gives you a low-cost way to watch a set of accounts
拉 @ 了授权账号的推文。要实时的话用本插件的事件源，不必自己定时拉: Fetch tweets that @mention the authorized account. For real-time updates, use this plugin's event source instead of polling on your own schedule
拉一个 X 列表里所有成员的推文——盯一批账号时，比逐个拉时间线省几十倍请求: Fetch tweets from every member of an X list — when watching a group of accounts, this saves dozens of times the requests compared to pulling each timeline individually
拉授权账号的私信事件；给了会话 id 则只拉那个会话: Fetch DM events for the authorized account; if a conversation id is given, only fetches that conversation
拉某个账号自己发的推文（可含/不含转推与回复）: Fetch the tweets an account has posted itself (optionally including retweets and replies)
拿授权账号自己试一次（约 $0.01）。ok=false 表示要重新授权: Tries it once with the authorized account itself (costs about $0.01). ok=false means you need to re-authorize
按 id 批量取推文详情，一次最多 100 条: Batch-fetch tweet details by id, up to 100 at a time
按发出顺序；中途失败时这里是**已经发出去的那几条**: In the order they were sent; if it fails partway through, this contains **only the tweets that were actually sent**
按时间正序（老的在前），与游标推进方向一致: Chronological order (oldest first), matching the direction the cursor advances
按查询式搜最近 7 天的公开推文（自助档只有 7 天，全量存档是 Enterpr: Search public tweets from the last 7 days by query (self-service tiers are limited to 7 days; full archive search is Enterprise)
按用户名或 id 查账号资料；都留空则查授权账号自己: Look up an account's profile by username or id; if both are blank, looks up the authorized account itself
按顺序逐条发出，后一条自动回复前一条。**一条一段**，别把整篇文章塞进一项——: Sent one by one in order, with each tweet automatically replying to the previous one. **One tweet per item** — don't cram a whole article into one item, this operation won't split it for you
整条回复树/推串的根 id，用它把一串回复归堆: The root ID of the whole reply tree/thread, used to group a chain of replies together
普通账号上限 280 字符（中日韩字算 2 个权重的规则由 X 判定）；带投票或: 280-character limit for regular accounts (CJK characters count as weight 2 under X's rules); can be left blank when attaching a poll or sending media only
本批最新一条的 id；没有新内容时原样返回传入的游标: The ID of the newest item in this batch; returns the input cursor unchanged when there's nothing new
来自「上传媒体」且用途选了「私信用」: From "Upload media" with purpose set to "For DMs"
来自「上传媒体」操作，最多 4 个（视频/GIF 只能 1 个）: From the "Upload media" operation, up to 4 (only 1 for video/GIF)
点「授权」后由平台写入，勿手填: Written by the platform after you click "Authorize" — don't fill in by hand
留空 = 拉全部会话: Leave blank to fetch all conversations
类型非 original 时有值: Has a value when type is not original
绑到「发推文」的媒体 id 上: Attach to the media id of "Post tweet"
给某个用户或某个会话发私信。对方未关注你且未开放私信时会被拒: Send a DM to a user or conversation. Rejected if the recipient doesn't follow you and hasn't opened their DMs
给读屏用户的图片描述，≤1000 字符。视频不支持: Image description for screen-reader users, ≤1000 characters. Not supported for video
被引用的推文 id: The ID of the quoted tweet
默认 1000。X 对连续发推有速率限制，间隔太短整串会发一半断在中途: Defaults to 1000. X rate-limits rapid posting, so too short an interval can leave a thread half-posted
默认 300。X 的搜索/提及限流是 15 分钟 300 次，但真正的约束是钱—: Defaults to 300. X limits search/mentions to 300 calls per 15 minutes, but the real constraint is cost — every tweet fetched in each poll is billed
默认 50，上限 100；自动翻页。**每条都计费**（读一条约 $0.005）: Defaults to 50, up to 100; auto-paginates. **Every item is billed** (about $0.005 per read) — don't casually turn this up
